# OneGroup

> OneGroup is a comprehensive insurance broker specializing in commercial coverage, industry-specific solutions, and risk management across construction, healthcare, manufacturing, agriculture, and public sector organizations.

OneGroup provides tailored insurance and risk management solutions for businesses across multiple industries, with particular expertise in construction, healthcare, manufacturing, agriculture, and life sciences. The company offers a full range of commercial insurance products including liability, property, cyber, workers' compensation, and specialized coverage for regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- Business Insurance
- Industry Expertise

- Workers' Compensation

## Business Insurance Solutions

- [Business Insurance](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance): OneGroup's business insurance offerings including liability, cyber, and workers' compensation.
- [General Liability](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/general-liability): General liability insurance protecting against lawsuits, property damage, and bodily injury.
- [Property and Casualty](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/property-and-casualty): Commercial property and casualty insurance protecting business assets in NY.
- [Cyber Insurance](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/cyber-insurance): Cyber liability insurance protecting against data breaches, ransomware, and cyber threats.
- [Professional Liability](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/professional-liability): Professional liability and directors & officers insurance with asset protection.
- [Automobile Liability](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/automobile-liability): Auto liability coverage for commercial vehicles and fleet insurance in NY.
- [Employee Disability](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/employee-disability): Employee disability coverage with NY statutory requirements and income protection.
- [Alternate Risk Financing](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/alternate-risk-financing): Captive insurance and risk retention group solutions for alternative risk financing.
- [Inland Marine](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/inland-marine): Inland marine insurance for equipment, tools, and materials in transit or on-site.
- [Pollution and Environmental Insurance](https://onegroup.com/business-insurance/pollution-and-environmental-insurance): Pollution liability insurance covering spills, cleanup costs, and regulatory claims.

## Industry Expertise

- [Industry Expertise Overview](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise): OneGroup's industry expertise across construction, healthcare, manufacturing, agriculture, and social services.
- [Construction](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/construction): Construction insurance with workers' compensation, surety bonds, and NY compliance support.
- [Healthcare](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/healthcare): Healthcare provider insurance with Medicare compliance and long-term care solutions.
- [Manufacturing](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/manufacturing): Manufacturing insurance covering operations, equipment, workers' comp, and product liability.
- [Agriculture](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/agriculture): Specialized insurance and risk management solutions for agriculture industry and farm operations.
- [Life Sciences](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/life-sciences): Life sciences insurance with biotech coverage and intellectual property protection.
- [Food Products](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/food-products): Food products insurance with FSMA compliance, product recall, and contamination coverage.
- [Public Sector Solutions](https://onegroup.com/industry-expertise/public-sector-solutions): Public sector solutions for schools, government agencies with compliance and cybersecurity.

## Specialized Coverage

- [Egg Production](https://onegroup.com/egg-production): Tailored insurance and risk management for egg production and poultry businesses.

## Claims & Support

- [Claims](https://onegroup.com/claims): Claims reporting and support for commercial, personal, and workers' compensation claims.
